row.evidence: DataVisor publishes no pricing (Contact Sales only) and no public SCIM or SSO documentation; its platform pages mention only role-based access controls.
row.notes: Quote-only: no pricing page (datavisor.com/pricing 404); Contact Sales connects you with a fraud expert to 'tailor the right solution'. DataVisor is an enterprise fraud/AML platform for banks and fintechs. Product docs (docs.datavisor.com) redirect to the admin.datavisor.com login, and the public help centre has 3 articles, none on users or SSO. Not in the Okta OIN (no search results) or the Entra SaaS tutorial index. Status unknown.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML or SSO mention on any public DataVisor page checked; docs.datavisor.com redirects to the admin.datavisor.com login and the Zendesk help centre has only 3 public articles (services and training).

user_api.notes: DataVisor's public API references cover fraud-event ingestion and decisioning; the API Guide is a download and no user-management API is documented publicly.

okta.notes: Okta OIN search for 'datavisor': no results found (rendered page).

entra.notes: No DataVisor entry in the Entra SaaS tutorial index (toc.yml).

fallbacks.notes: docs.datavisor.com redirects to the admin.datavisor.com login; the full API Guide is a download.
